v1.2.description:
## What's New
* Added more logic to the shop to spread it more evenly across multiple spheres of logic using the coin multiplier as the basis
* Added a logic requirement for the double jump check as it requires XP gained from accessing later areas of the map

NOTE: This is fully untested and won't be till a later date.

## Known Issues:
* Client disconnect is not properly clearing all state- for now, please reset your save on the main menu if you change slots.
* Some shop-related logic bugs

## Setup
To install the client mod:
1. Get the Tamper Monkey extension for your browser
2. Install the script from below by clicking it (should install automatically)
3. Navigate to https://www.coolmathgames.com/0-johnny-upgrade
4. Have fun :)
v1.2.title: Johnny Upgrade v1.2

v1.3.description:
## What's New
* Total logic overhaul: no more frame perfect inputs and crazy tech in logic by default (turn on knockback and recoil boosts if you want the full speedrunner experience, just know you'll be expected to BLJ knockback boost using spikes, boost backwards with the gun to reach coins in shorter time, etc.)
* More logic in shops to spread more evenly across logic spheres and reduce the early grind some (depends some on your multiworld size)
* Added a logic requirement for the double jump check as it requires XP gained from accessing later areas of the map
* G and H hotkeys added to collapse/hide the archipelago view

## Known Issues
* In-game log shows item and location IDs instead of names

## Setup
To install the client mod:
1. Get the Tamper Monkey extension for your browser
2. Install the script from below by clicking it (should install automatically)
3. Navigate to https://www.coolmathgames.com/0-johnny-upgrade
4. Have fun :)
